calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, calendar_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date = '2026-10-15'

SELECT MIN(calendar_date) as earliest, MAX(calendar_date) as latest
FROM dim_date

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, MIN(calendar_date) as period_start, MAX(calendar_date) as period_end
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period
LIMIT 20

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, MIN(calendar_date) as period_start, MAX(calendar_date) as period_end
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT wo.web_order_id) as total_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wo.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as click_collect_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wo.fulfilment_type = 'home_delivery' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as home_delivery_orders
FROM fact_web_order wo
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(wo.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

  COUNT(DISTINCT wo.web_order_id) as total_orders,

WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'

GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
